text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 370 January 31, 1972
TRANSFERRING THE ADMINISTRATION AND CUSTODY OF THE AGUINALDO MANSION IN
KAWIT, CAVITE, FROM THE NATIONAL MUSEUM TO THE NATIONAL HISTORICAL
COMMISSION
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby transfer the administration and custody of the Aguinaldo Mansion in Kawit, Cavite, from the National
Museum to the National Historical Commission.
Executive Order No. 73 dated March 13, 1964, and other orders inconsistent herewith are hereby revoked or
amended accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 31st day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
